question: Under the 'Jiyo Parsi' scheme launched by the Government of India Rupees _______ is the maximum amount of childcare support per child per month only up to the age of 18 years as per the guidelines w.e.f. 22ⁿd Oct 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is __8000.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Jiyo Parsi__

 __
 
• ​__Jiyo Parsi is a government of India initiative to stop the Parsi Zoroastrian Community's population loss in India. The Ministry of Minority Affairs (MOMA) and the Parzor Foundation created the Jiyo Parsi Scheme, which consists of three parts:
 
• Medical Assistance component- To provide financial assistance to Parsi married couples for medical treatment under standard medical protocols;
 
• Advocacy component- To undertake advocacy/ outreach programmes to generate awareness among Parsi population for lineage enhancement;
 
• Health of Community Component- For creche/ child care support and assistance to elderly people.
 
• Initially, the Jiyo Parsi scheme's primary goal had been to provide funding for various forms of ART (Artificial Reproductive Technology). But it soon became clear that in order to address the community's grave demographic problem, it would have to go beyond fertility difficulties and evolve into a comprehensive movement. The updated plan, which MOMA wef released on October 22nd 2021, consists of three parts.
 
• The Ministry of Minority Affairs launched the 'Jiyo Parsi' scheme in November 2013, for which a budget of Rs 4 to 5 crore is provided every year.
 
• Parsi couples will now be eligible to receive Rs 4,000 per month for childcare for every child under the age of eight; they will also receive Rs 4,000 for every elderly dependent they care for; and elderly Parsis will be paid Rs 3,000 per month for every child under the age of ten. These benefits are available to Parsi couples whose combined income is less than Rs 15 lakh lakh per annum.
